decisions.reason: The source decision concerns KiCad 9 compatibility of 3D-model reference variables. It does not necessarily change the independently verified L1 footprint resolution or physical-match requirement.
KiCad 3D-model reference compatibility does not change the legacy main-board BOM or its connector-population policy.
The sensor-board BOM content requirement is independent of the integrated board's KiCad 3D-model path variables.
The source modifies 3D-model reference portability, not power-board BOM contents, sourcing data, or population decisions.
Requiring KiCad 9-compatible 3D-model references does not alter the integrated design's cost, architecture, connector-reduction, or component-selection policies.
The required sensor-board Gerber, drill, and placement exports remain unchanged by the integrated board's 3D-model reference compatibility rule.
KiCad 9 path-variable compatibility for 3D models does not change the selected through-hole connector assembly style.
The source identifies a 3D-viewer model-reference issue, not missing or incorrect entries in the already verified integrated-board BOM.
The standalone USB power architecture and rail behavior are unaffected by the KiCad variable used for 3D-model references.
The source does not change ESP32 breakout pin coverage, placement, connector style, or pitch.
The KiCad 9 3D-model reference constraint does not alter any connector location, grouping, accessibility, or enclosure-fit requirement.
The source concerns tooling paths for 3D models and does not change any ESP32-S3 GPIO assignment or compatibility rule.
